steps.title: Scaffold
steps.body: glean-idx deploy generates a Docker image and Terraform for a Kubernetes CronJob on GKE or EKS.

steps.title: Foundation
steps.body: Generated Terraform does not create the project or account, cluster, registry, workload identity foundation, or namespace. The platform team owns them.

steps.title: Configure
steps.body: Change glean_deployment.yaml. Generated Terraform is an artifact, not the configuration interface.

steps.title: Schedule
steps.body: Full and incremental schedules need separate deployment configurations.

steps.title: Secrets
steps.body: The workload gets exact secret access and cannot enumerate secrets.

steps.title: Verify
steps.body: A completed Job proves only that the process exited successfully. Check document status.
